source: config/calibration_candidates.json (Auditor B, fit 2021-2024 for deployment; 2021-23 fit / 2024 tuned / 2025 holdout-scored once for validation)
rollback: set "active": false (rebuild history) or remove a market; probabilities then revert to the raw Champion output
domain: applied only for lines within +/-50% of the model mean; positions listed per market; mean_scale entries change the model mean itself at build time and apply at every line

rec_tds.note: Structural mean correction (Champion TD mean overstated). Fit 2021-24 on realised/predicted TD totals; walk-forward Brier gain at P(>=1) positive in 2023/2024/2025 for rec_tds and atd, mixed for rush_tds (lower confidence). Not subject to the +/-50% line band.
